remarks: Bring your vision to life with this spacious 2-bedroom, 1-bath Co-Op in a prime Stamford location. This end unit fixer-upper can be yours with some TLC and personal touches.  The building itself is well-maintained, offering amenities like on-site laundry and trash pickup, as well as a secure entry and assigned parking.  Located just minutes from downtown Stamford, you'll have easy access to fantastic shopping, dining, and entertainment. Commuting is a breeze with close proximity to I-95, the Merritt Parkway, and the Stamford Metro-North train station.  This is a rare opportunity to own a home in Stamford at an affordable price and make it your own. Don't miss out-schedule a showing today!
